final.final_answer:
Here are the directions comparisons from Google Maps for Eiffel Tower → Louvre Museum:

Walking (previously visible on the Walking tab)
- Time: 46–47 minutes
- Distance: 3.3–3.4 km
- Main route: via Rue de l’Université (with a common variant continuing via Rue de l’Université and Quai Valéry Giscard d’Estaing)

Public transit (Transit tab, currently active)
- Fastest visible option:
  - Time: 23 minutes
  - Distance: Not explicitly shown in the transit summary (Google Maps typically omits distance for these bus routes on this panel)
  - Main transit line / route: Bus 72
  - Outline: Walk, then take Bus 72 at Pont d’Iéna (departure around 11:27), with about 10 minutes of walking in total.
- Other visible transit options for context:
  - 30 min: Walk, then Bus 69
  - 27 min: Walk, then commuter train RER C, then walk (marked with a warning)
  - 25 min: Walk, then Bus 42, then Métro line 1

Recommendation
- Faster option: Public transit (Bus 72 route) at about 23 minutes is clearly faster than walking (46–47 minutes).
- If you prioritize speed, take the transit option with Bus 72. If you prefer a scenic and simple route and don’t mind the extra time, walking via Rue de l’Université is a good alternative.

No navigation was started; this is based only on the visible summary information in Google Maps’ directions panel.
